post.description: Data IN – Create new and/or modify existing Link Contexts in the GRP if they are associated to GS1 Keys (GTIN, GLN, GIAI etc.) derived from licences assigned to your MO. The licence must already exist in the GRP, the licence status must be “active”. Please note: If a Link is associated with a GTIN or GLN, it is NOT required to have a record for this key in the GTIN or GLN Registry.
